records.title: 1492年：Shido Amin的象师游记署注
records.description: 理念将Ghavaanaj驯象者、mahouts及魔法reeshi的描述署Shido Amin《Wandering with the Herd》1492。R72仅为文化/地区检索接口，不证明Dhugajir已于1492统一。 此为已封存MOD理念的有年叙述，证据等级保持单一游戏文本；不自动修改政权、疆界或宗属。

dateEvidence.precision: explicit year in MOD narrative / diegetic quotation
dateEvidence.quote:
‘The Ghavaanaj of eastern Rahen, inhabiting the lands between the scorching Marutha desert and the lowlands along the banks of the Kharunyana, have always held the elephants with whom they share their homeland in the highest regard. Festivals and religious ceremonies abound in their honor, and having a tamed elephant to call their own is the pride of every village. Even their kings, back when they were an independent realm, sat on a throne made of the finest ivory.’

’Given the importance of elephants to their culture, it is no surprise that the mahouts that tame and control elephants are considered to possess a truly prestigious role. But even they bow to the reeshi, the legendary elephant binders of Rahen, who use their magical powers to forge unbreakable bonds between elephant and man, allowing them to commune with the animals under their charge. I had the privilege of experiencing firsthand how deep that bond goes during my time deep in the jungles of Devighol. I must confess I have come to the firm conclusion that truly understanding the divine law of the world requires first understanding the creatures with whom we share this world.’
- Shido Amin, Wandering with the Herd: Account of my time amongst the elephant binders of Dhujat, 1492
